title: Whispers in Pastel Mist
description: Two ethereal, faceless figures with flowing curly hair face each other closely in the lower half of the composition. Their forms dissolve into soft pastel clouds of color while vertical white and green brushstrokes rise above them like candles or a spectral city skyline against a pale, misty background with swirling colorful lines and delicate sparkles.
prompt: ethereal abstract painting of two faceless figures with swirling curly hair facing each other, their bodies merging into soft pastel clouds of peach, pink, purple and mint green, vertical white and green brushstrokes rising above them like glowing candles or a spectral city, delicate colorful swirls and tiny sparkles floating in the air, soft dreamy atmosphere with lots of negative space, delicate watercolor and acrylic style with gentle blending
